claims.statement: The alert captured 10 incoming transfers to account 21749/801F05EF0 from 10 distinct sending accounts between 2022-09-05 and 2022-09-09, all via ACH in Euro.
The same account then made four outgoing transfers to four distinct counterparties between 2022-09-09 and 2022-09-13, completing a gather-scatter pattern.
Three of the alerted sending accounts (8001DB9C0, 801ADF5B0, 800AA6350) each match a gather-scatter pattern in their own right, per run_pattern_check on the anchor account.

findings.narrative: Alert AL-986d0280c6ee fired on a fan-in pattern: account 21749/801F05EF0 received from 10 different accounts in 10 transfers over 96 hours. The same account also matches a gather-scatter pattern (run_pattern_check): it gathered from 10 distinct senders then scattered to 4 distinct receivers in 14 transfers over 8 days. The 10 incoming transfers (all ACH, all one-time counterparties) total 63.0M EUR, dominated by a single 62.9M EUR transfer from 800F2EAC0. Three of those senders (8001DB9C0, 801ADF5B0, 800AA6350) themselves exhibit gather-scatter behaviour. The hub account is new (first activity 2022-09-01) and its entire history is 17 transfers: one self reinvestment, the 10 alerted inflows, four outflows (5.1K EUR, 9.7M EUR, 12.1K USD, 3.7K USD), and two EUR-to-USD self conversions. No ordinary business explanation fits the extreme amount skew, the one-time counterparties, and the chained gather-scatter structure.
